searchText: Wouldn't this be a non consensus change, so any client could implement it? Or are you suggesting that the block body change? What's your favourite algebra crate for Rust, or failing that, for C? Been looking at Axiom, because it's pretty permissively licensed, but it also seems like overkill for solving some basic polynomials... <@!301186049323958275> this would be a change to the way transactions are encoded in blocks. What do you mean by a `ton consensus change`? Sorry, typo. Fixed. <@!301186049323958275> oh well yeah, it doesn't affect the core consensus, but I imagine that it would need to be implemented by all clients and also wallets so that they take advantage of it => so it would require a fork Turns out I was just looking for z3 all along 🤷‍♂️ I suppose rollup nodes could communicate (also) via webrtc, making it possible to have light nodes in js
